mines.mine_notes: Underground copper-gold-silver mine, Zacatecas. 2025: 1,210 kt mill feed @ 1.52% Cu, 0.84 g/t Au, 21.9 g/t Ag; produced 36,583 klbs Cu, 26,700 oz Au, 542,046 oz Ag, 249 klbs Mo = 83,149 GEO. GEO conversion uses Aranzazu realized metal prices. Infill/deep drilling at Glory Hole completed 2025; Esperança new zone promising.
Open-pit heap-leach gold mine, Honduras. 2025 grade 0.44 g/t, recovery 65.25%. 2025 guidance noted lower grades due to mine sequencing and wetter rainy season vs 2024.

Open-pit gold mine, Tocantins. 2025 production +5% YoY at installed capacity. Paiol underground under development (initial UG production planned 2028); Vira Saia OP planned 2027; Cata Funda 2030; 12-year LOM to 2037 incl. stockpiles. Infill program at Paiol UG added reserves; new S-K 1300 TRS filed.
mines.reserve_tonnes_mt_note: Paiol OP 418 koz (17,527 kt @ 0.74); Paiol UG 180 koz (4,817 kt @ 1.16); Cata Funda 81 koz; Vira Saia 135 koz; heap-leach & stockpile 77 koz

mines.mine_notes: Open-pit gold mine (Ernesto/Pau-a-Pique), Mato Grosso. Nosde pit licence delays in 2024 pushed back production; two years of lower production/higher AISC expected before recovery from 2027. 2025 reserves -6% after depletion despite higher prices. Exploration focused on Nosde–Lavrinha corridor (11 km drilling).

mines.mine_notes: Open-pit gold mine, Rio Grande do Norte. Ramp-up began Q1 2025 (first production end-March); commercial production H2 2025. Built in 19 months for $188M CAPEX. Updated FS (March 2026): ~57 koz/y avg, 35-year LOM at 2 Mtpa after highway (BR-226) relocation approved. Reserves +170% vs 2024.
mines.reserve_tonnes_mt_note: 70,600 kt @ 0.88 g/t Au (incl. 3.2 Mt stockpiled material)

mines.mine_notes: Gold mine, Goiás. Acquired from AngloGold Ashanti; acquisition closed Dec 2, 2025 — Aura consolidated December production only (4,761 GEO). Accounted as business combination. New S-K 1300 TRS filed as 20-F exhibit. High first-month costs reflect ramp of consolidation.

Development-stage underground gold project (formerly Cerro Blanco), Jutiapa. Acquired via Bluestone Resources (closed 2025). FS completed Dec 2025 (Ausenco): 1,600 t/d, ~17-year LOM, avg ~111 koz GEO first 4 years. TRS filed as 20-F exhibit. (April 2026 MRMR release section header said 'Brazil'; 20-F confirms Guatemala.)
mines.reserve_tonnes_mt_note: 8,747 kt @ 6.01 g/t Au; plus 5,736 koz Ag (20.40 g/t)

mines.mine_notes: Development-stage gold project, Mato Grosso. No P&P reserves established at X1. Satellite targets: Pé Quente purchase option exercised 2025 ($4.5M; Indicated 124 koz @ 0.68 g/t, Inferred 163 koz @ 0.77 g/t); Serrinhas (Indicated 84 koz @ 1.01 g/t, Inferred 118 koz @ 0.79 g/t). Amended TRS filed as 20-F exhibit (March 2026).
Gold mine, Mato Grosso, in care and maintenance.
Copper exploration project, Pará. 2025: 11,000 m drilling (21,000+ m total in 2023–2024); 0.2–0.5% Cu over ~50 m in disseminated zones; higher-grade >0.5% Cu intervals. Geophysics planned 2026.

notes: 2025 GEO production 280,414 oz at current prices (276,036 constant prices; 285,380 at guidance prices ex-MSG) — record high, guidance achieved. Consolidated cash cost $1,136/GEO, AISC $1,458/GEO. Revenue $921.7M (+55% YoY). Consolidated P&P reserves Dec 31, 2025: 7,223k GEO (6,614,660 oz Au + Aranzazu 6,971 koz Ag + Era Dorada 5,736 koz Ag; Aranzazu Cu 278 Mlb). Reserve price assumptions raised: Au $2,600/oz (from $2,000), Cu $4.40/lb (from $4.20), Ag $35.00/oz (from $25.00). All amounts in USD. Costs reported per GEO (gold equivalent ounce).
